note: TWO HUMAN-BUILT Syr Vondam blink decks, kept as a COMPARISON TARGET for the generator and nothing else. The owner linked them on 31 Aug 2026 with the words 'this is just to test our system against, not to copy'. Only card NAMES are recorded, which are facts about what is in a deck rather than anything authored, and nothing here is ingested into the product, shown to a user, or used to build a deck. CLAUDE.md rules Moxfield out as a DATA SOURCE and that stands: this is two pages a person pointed at, read once, to score ourselves against. Do not write a scraper.
whatToScore: BOTH halves together. The blink group below, AND counters. The blink half. The generator already finds the aristocrats half of Vondam on its own, because 'dies' is read and 'is put into exile' was not. These three groups are the thing that was missing.
whyTwo: One deck is one builder's opinion. Two independent decks AGREEING on a card is evidence that the card belongs to the archetype rather than to a person's taste, so the shared core below is the part worth scoring hardest against.

notATheme.note: Deck two runs Swords to Plowshares and Path to Exile and deck one does not. So they are not WRONG for Vondam, they are simply not the theme. Before the direction fix the generator filled with them because eff:exile was 0.45 of his plan, and the failure was never that removal is bad, it was that removal was being counted as synergy.

twoStrategiesAtOnce.note: The owner, 1 Sep 2026: "syr vondom sunstar i gave you 2 example decks for blink/+1 (this commander benefits from 2 strategies together)". So the target is NOT a blink deck. It is a deck that does blink AND +1/+1 counters at the same time, because his one trigger pays out on both: a creature of yours dying OR being exiled puts a counter on him.
twoStrategiesAtOnce.consequence: Scoring the blink half alone is how a correct answer gets marked wrong, and how a deck that abandons counters to chase blink gets marked right. Both halves are the deck. His plan already asks for cost:sacrifice 0.90, eff:exile-own 0.85, trig:dies 0.85 and ctr:+1/+1 0.80 together, which is the right shape; the failure is in SELECTION, not in the plan.
